definitions.ask: Should an untracked session also drop out of Pomodoro counts, not just minutes?
definitions.why: #untracked means not tracked; a lunch counted as a Pomodoro would still inflate the day

choices.label: Untracked sessions vanish from every aggregate (minutes, counts, homes, Day strip)
Untracked sessions still count as one Pomodoro each; only their minutes drop

definitions.ask: Should Obsidian's se<X> + Tab mirror capture's new MEET start behavior?
definitions.why: one gesture should write the same ledger from both front doors, pinned by shared vectors

choices.label: se + Tab on a MEET uses the event-run span and [t::] rule, plus the run-past-event Notice
se<X> + Tab keeps its timing but omits [t::] when the MEET's event run is untracked
Obsidian starts stay as today; an untracked MEET started there keeps [t::]

definitions.ask: Should non-MEET starts and extends also warn when they run past an untracked event?
definitions.why: untracked means off the clock, not optional; the warning never blocks

choices.label: Every open Event Task warns, tracked or untracked (a lunch is still a commitment)
Untracked events never warn (better if they are mostly focus blockers)

definitions.ask: Should glossary:event-task say an #untracked Event Task keeps its session off the clock?
definitions.corrects: Its `[root:: NOTE]` attributes meeting time to an area or project, and a Pomodoro Task Link under the daily note's ledger records the session.

definitions.ask: Should a new record say untracked sessions omit [t::], superseding part of synced-meetings-link-by-phase?
definitions.corrects: Back-to-back or overlapping past meetings share one closed MEET whose span is the cluster (next start ≤ cluster end).

strands: Synced Meetings Are Linked By Phase At Birth
